logic.summary: Long-only M30 Donchian: buy when the last closed bar closes above the prior 40-bar high; exit when it closes below the prior 10-bar low.
logic.economic_rationale: Classic turtle-style channel breakout: volatility expansion beyond a 40-bar range tends to persist; asymmetric 10-bar exit cuts failed breakouts quickly.
known_assumptions: Channels are computed from shift 2 onward so the signal bar (shift 1) never contaminates its own channel.
Sell side is implemented but disabled (BREAKOUT_ENABLE_SELL=false).
rejection_criteria: Net Out-of-Sample expectancy <= 0 after M30 spread/slippage.
Profit concentrated in fewer than 3 trending episodes.
